mapper.select: select Add_Date from yh_org_tree where Org_Code=(select Org_Id from yh_user_make_card where Enrol_Card_Id=#{cardid})
select Add_Date from yh_org_tree where Org_Code=#{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select * from yh_org_tree where province=#{province} or city=#{province} or county=#{province}
select Org_Code,county,count(*) as num from yh_org_tree where city LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{name}), '%') group by county having count(1)>1 or count(1)>0;
select Org_Code,city,count(*) as num from yh_org_tree where province=#{name} group by city having count(1)>1 or count(1)>0;
select Org_Code,province,count(*) as num from yh_org_tree where Org_Code LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgCode}), '%') group by province having count(1)>1 or count(1)>0 ;
select tr.*,info.user_name,info.name,info.mobile,info.user_pwd from yh_org_tree tr left join yh_user_reginfo info on tr.User_Code=info.user_code where tr.Org_Code= #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select * from yh_org_tree where Org_Name=#{orgName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select * from yh_org_tree where Super_Org_Code=#{superOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select yot.Org_Code,Org_Name,Org_Note,Super_Org_Code, yumc.doctor, concat(yuai.user_name, "(", count(1),")") as doctorName from yh_org_tree yot inner join yh_user_make_card yumc on yumc.Org_Id = yot.Org_Code and yumc.User_Code is null inner join yh_user_admin_info yuai on yuai.id = yumc.doctor WHERE yot.Org_Code LIKE CONCAT(#{orgCode}, '%') group by yot.Org_Code, yumc.doctor
select Org_Code from yh_org_tree WHERE Org_Code LIKE CONCAT(#{orgCode}, '%');

SELECT Org_Code,Org_Name,Org_Note,Super_Org_Code FROM yh_org_tree WHERE Org_Code IN ( SELECT Org_Id FROM `yh_user_make_card` WHERE doctor=#{doctorid} GROUP BY Org_id)
select max(Org_Code) from yh_org_tree where Super_Org_Code=#{superOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select tr.Org_Code,tr.Org_Name,tr.Super_Org_Code,tr.Add_Date,tr.User_Code,info.user_name from yh_org_tree tr left join yh_user_reginfo info on tr.User_Code=info.user_code

SELECT tr.Org_Code, tr.Org_Name, tr.Super_Org_Code, tr.Add_Date, tr.User_Code, info.user_name, CONCAT( count(mc.User_Code), '/', count(mc.Org_Id) ) AS stuck, ( SELECT count(*) FROM yh_user_admin_info WHERE org_code = tr.Org_Code ) AS doctor, tr.standby FROM yh_org_tree tr LEFT JOIN yh_user_reginfo info ON tr.User_Code = info.user_code COLLATE utf8_general_ci LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card AS mc ON tr.Org_Code = mc.Org_Id WHERE tr.Org_Code LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{orgCode}), '%') GROUP BY tr.Org_Code

Org_Code = #{orgName}

limit 1
